title: Prompt-ablation endpoint-capability test: does system-prompt goal/schema enumeration convert the parent's step-0 reveal-click into a full click-then-answer completion for the largest credential-free Qwen models (7B, 3B), and what is the demonstrable credential-free multi-step Web-agent capability ceiling across all credential-free endpoints and local models actually available (0.5B/3B/7B GGUFs, anonymous proxy) as measured and bounded by a frozen protocol plus a time-boxed external check?
question: Under the same credential-free, CPU-quantized constraints as EXP-INTEL-37982024058, does supplying the task goal and the action schema in the system prompt (removing the underspecification identified by audit VF-01, in the style of the grandparent harness min_webagent.py) convert M-7B-QWEN's or M-3B-QWEN's step-0 reveal-click into a full click-then-answer completion of the minimal Web-agent task; and if it does not, what is the demonstrable capability ceiling for that task across ALL credential-free endpoints and local models actually available to the factory (local 0.5B/3B/7B Qwen2.5 Q4_K_M GGUFs, anonymous gpt-oss-20b proxy), as bounded by a time-boxed external check of published results for comparably sized local models? The packet must return an explicit close/re-scope recommendation resolving readiness condition (3).
hypothesis: H1: At least one of M-7B-QWEN, M-3B-QWEN, or (ceiling-completeness) M-0.5B-QWEN will clear the pre-declared capability bar (task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 over 5 seeded episodes under the deterministic protocol) under the goal/schema-enriched prompt P_treat (which enumerates the goal 'click the button, then answer it' and the action schema without leaking the literal answer TARGET-42), thereby converting the parent FALSIFIES (bounded by audit VF-01 to the underspecified prompt) into SUPPORTS at the P_treat protocol and unblocking the frozen C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark (readiness condition 3). H1a is the primary capability claim (capability exists); H1b is the secondary attribution claim (the prompt is the identified driver, i.e. the same candidate under the frozen comparator prompt P_comp does NOT clear the bar); H1b is evaluated per clearing candidate via the unconditional paired comparator cell and does not gate the primary outcome.
falsifier: H0: Even with the goal/schema-enriched prompt P_treat, none of M-7B-QWEN, M-3B-QWEN, or M-0.5B-QWEN clears the bar (task_success_rate < 0.6 in every evaluated candidate, i.e. <= 2/5 each), and the within-experiment comparator arms reproduce the parent's VF-01 failure mode (0/5 success, re-click loop, answer_action_emission_rate 0.0), confirming the failure is below the P_treat ceiling. Then the demonstrable capability ceiling for the minimal Web-agent task across all credential-free endpoints actually available (0.5B/3B/7B local GGUFs re-measured under the identical protocol; anonymous gpt-oss-20b proxy carried as non-reproducible reference) is below the bar, and the bounded external check either (a) finds no published evidence that any comparably sized credential-free-local model clears an equal-or-harder multi-step Web-agent task, licensing an explicit re-scope of the four-arm benchmark off the credential-free path, or (b) points at a specific credible external result to verify in a bounded follow-up before closing.

P_TREAT_GOAL_SCHEMA.provenance: Derived from the grandparent harness SYS constant in research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37973264582/raw/code/min_webagent.py (bound in freeze_artifacts), with the single field-name adaptation ref -> selector required by the parent task schema. Adds exactly the two dimensions audit VF-01 says the parent prompt lacked: (a) enumeration of the action schema and (b) the task goal sentence 'Click the button to reveal the code, then answer it.' Does NOT leak #reveal-btn or TARGET-42.
P_TREAT_GOAL_SCHEMA.verbatim: You are a web agent. Reply ONLY with one JSON object per turn, no prose. Actions available: {"action":"click","selector":"<id>"} or {"action":"answer","text":"<code>"}. Click the button to reveal the code, then answer it.

P_COMP_UNDERSPECIFIED.verbatim: You are a web agent. Reply with ONLY a valid JSON action per the schema. No prose, no reasoning, no markdown.

baselines.description: Uniform random action selection from the frozen 5-action valid space (click #reveal-btn, answer TARGET-41/42/43, answer unknown), 5 episodes, seeded RNG random.Random(42) created ONCE and reused across episodes (as in the parent harness), run against the SAME served task page through the SAME run_episode scorer as the candidates, via the repaired controls driver (prereg 6, Appendix A). NOTE: the parent measured this control on an un-navigated about:blank page (its null-random mode never calls page.goto to the served port), which made click_ok=false and task_success structurally 0; this experiment repairs that control-sensitivity defect (verified mechanically at DESIGN time, prereg 13).

positive_control.description: Two positive controls with stable IDs, both executed on the SAME served task page and through the SAME run_episode scorer used for candidates. (1) PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING (gate; ID inherited from the parent): 10 constrained-decoding probes per model per prompt condition with probe 'Emit exactly: {"action":"click","selector":"#test"}'; verifies the GBNF decoder + strict parser produce schema-valid JSON under the prompt condition actually used for that arm (run as the A1 gate under P_treat and as a reference under P_comp). (2) PC-ORACLE-EPISODE (NEW; scorer-path canary): 5 scripted episodes in which a fixed oracle producer emits click #reveal-btn then answer TARGET-42, executed through the SAME episode scorer (run_episode in the frozen parent harness) that scores candidate episodes; proves the full success path (click -> reveal detected -> answer registered -> task_success=true) can fire under the exact implementation that will score the experiment.
positive_control.success_criterion: PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING: 10/10 schema-valid JSON per model per prompt condition. PC-ORACLE-EPISODE: 5/5 task_success=true with revealed_value=TARGET-42 in all 5 scripted episodes.
positive_control.failure_mode_policy: PC-JSON failure for a candidate under the treatment prompt -> that candidate is excluded from treatment evaluation (decoding_infrastructure_failure), never a capability verdict. PC-ORACLE < 5/5 -> scoring pipeline broken; OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID regardless of candidate results, because the scorer cannot register success.

null_control.description: 5 episodes with fixed non-JSON content ('I will click the button') driven through the same run_episode scorer against the SAME served task page (via the repaired controls driver, prereg 6); verifies the verification logic rejects non-parseable actions and that the authoring cannot accidentally award success.

measurement_validity: Same minimal Web-agent task as the parent (click #reveal-btn then answer the revealed value TARGET-42 on the identical synthetic page) for direct comparability across EXP-INTEL-37973264582, EXP-INTEL-37982024058 and this experiment.

Same harness code as the audited parent: research/intel/run_exp_37982024058.py is REUSED UNMODIFIED for all model-backed measurement (sha256 bound in freeze_artifacts). All prompts, user template, task page, GBNF grammar, sampling and thresholds are config-driven; EXECUTE only transcribes per-condition harness_config.json files whose content is fully determined by the frozen strings in this packet (prereg sections 4-5) and the frozen parent fixture.

CONTROL-SENSITIVITY REPAIR (verified, not just claimed): the parent's null-random mode scored NC and B-RANDOM on an un-navigated about:blank page because run_episode reloads page.url and the mode never navigated to the served port. This experiment runs NC/B-RANDOM/PC-ORACLE through a new, fully specified controls driver that navigates to the served task page and guards on button presence; the driver source is frozen verbatim in prereg Appendix A with expected sha256 c2b00d4d1458354ec815c93b6ac2dcf3408c24c94807a4d3e1622b4eee7addc7. At DESIGN time the REAL run_episode scorer with only model/browser layers stubbed was executed against both the first-draft driver (sha 3865258d43807ef7bf24fdc8666b251b1273badafbbdfd179979af1446b42d7b, PC-ORACLE 0/5 -> structural MEASUREMENT_INVALID) and the repaired driver (PC-ORACLE 5/5, NC 0.0/0.0, B-RANDOM 0.2, navigation guard pass); see prereg 13 probes E-1/E-2.

Identical strict parsing rule: the full completion must be valid JSON matching the schema ({"action":"click","selector":"..."} or {"action":"answer","text":"..."}); any parse error, schema violation or missing required field is a parse failure.
Identical mechanical verification: Playwright drives system Chrome; success = clicked_reveal AND revealed_value==TARGET-42 AND final_answer==TARGET-42, with terminal page-state re-verification.
Constrained JSON decoding (GBNF) enforced for ALL candidate-model arms (treatment and comparator) to isolate model reasoning from formatting failures.
Same environment and serving stack as the parent: llama-cpp-python 0.2.90, chat_format=qwen, n_ctx=2048, temperature=0.0, max_tokens=512, seeds 42+episode_idx (42-46), CPU-only nproc=4, no GPU.

Candidate model set frozen: M-7B-QWEN (primary) then M-3B-QWEN (secondary) then M-0.5B-QWEN (ceiling-completeness; only if neither larger model clears); homogeneous family/quantization (Qwen2.5 Q4_K_M); artifacts pinned by URL + sha256 from parent/grandparent evidence; no post-freeze additions. Provisioning digest mismatch -> recorded provisioning_failure, never silent substitution.

Each evaluated model is measured under BOTH prompt conditions (treatment and comparator) on identical seeds, producing a within-experiment 2x2 (model x prompt; 3 model rows when the ceiling candidate is reached) evidence matrix; the paired comparator (A3) is collected for every candidate that reaches task evaluation, unconditionally before the A4 decision, so the prompt is identified as the driver within this packet for a clearing candidate.

New diagnostic metric answer_action_emission_rate (fraction of episodes emitting at least one valid answer action) added to the parent stable metric set; it directly measures the VF-01 re-click-loop transition.

Complete-cell rule: a cell with < 5 completed episodes is a measurement failure for that candidate (recorded run_error); an incomplete A2 cell disqualifies the candidate from clearing, and if no candidate completes a full A2 cell OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (fail-closed; a partial run never masquerades as a negative).

Raw evidence preserved per condition: model receipts (download URL, sha256, bytes, load time), per-episode raw completions, parsed actions, click_ok, reveal detection, final answer, step counts, latency, completion tokens, prompt_condition tag.

Bounded external capability check (prereg 8) is time-boxed (<= 30 min) and INFORMATIONAL: it records a structured capability envelope and feeds the pre-declared close/re-scope recommendation; it never overrides the local measurement outcome.

Deterministic protocol (temperature=0.0, fixed seeds): outcomes must be read as a deterministic-protocol result with zero within-cell variance, consistent with parent audit VF-03; the 3/5 bar is a pre-declared operational adequacy rule, not a significance test (see control_sensitivity evidence).
decision_rule: OUTCOME is exactly one of {SUPPORTS, FALSIFIES, MEASUREMENT_INVALID}; a separate secondary field prompt_attribution is exactly one of {PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED, NOT_PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED, UNDETERMINED}. P_treat = P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA (prereg 4.1); P_comp = P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED (prereg 4.2). Capability bar (inherited): task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 over the frozen 5-episode cell (seeds 42..46, temperature=0.0); 3/5 = 0.6 exactly; pre-declared adequacy rule, not a significance test. Candidate order (frozen): M-7B-QWEN (primary), then M-3B-QWEN (secondary), then M-0.5B-QWEN (ceiling-completeness; reached only if neither larger model clears under treatment). STOP at the first candidate that clears. STEP 0 PREFLIGHT (before any model load): run the frozen controls driver (prereg 6, Appendix A) against the served task page. Mandatory results: navigation_guard.pass==true; PC-ORACLE-EPISODE.task_success_rate==1.0 (5/5) and parseable_action_rate_step1==1.0; NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION.parseable_action_rate_step1==0.0 and task_success_rate==0.0; B-RANDOM-ACTION.parseable_action_rate_step1==1.0 and task_success_rate < 0.6. Any violation -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, with the exact failed control recorded; never a capability verdict. STEP 1 PROVISIONING per candidate (prereg 3.1): locate a file with the pinned sha256 or download from the frozen URL via the confirmed route, then sha256-verify BEFORE load; digest mismatch or download failure -> provisioning_failure for that candidate (recorded exactly), continue with the next candidate; if ALL candidates are unprovisionable -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID. STEP 2 PHASE A per candidate M_i in order: A1 run PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING under P_treat (harness probe-candidate mode); if pass_rate != 1.0 -> EXCLUDE M_i (decoding_infrastructure_failure), record, next candidate. A2 run the 5-episode treatment cell under P_treat -> T(m)=task_success_rate, P1(m)=parseable_action_rate_step1, AER(m)=answer_action_emission_rate; a cell with < 5 completed episodes (harness RUN_ERROR) is a measurement failure for that candidate: record it, treat the candidate as not-cleared, next candidate (fail-closed). A3 UNCONDITIONALLY (always, before A4) run the 5-episode comparator cell under P_comp for the SAME candidate -> C(m) (plus reference PC-JSON under P_comp); if the comparator PC gate fails or the comparator cell is incomplete, C(m)=UNDEFINED (recorded). A4 if T(m) >= 0.6 AND P1(m) >= 0.6 -> OUTCOME=SUPPORTS, status=COMPLETE; prompt_attribution by C(m): C(m) < 0.6 -> PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED; C(m) >= 0.6 -> NOT_PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED with a mandatory validity note; C(m)=UNDEFINED -> UNDETERMINED with a note. STOP. A5 else record not-cleared; next candidate. STEP 3 PHASE B (reached only when every candidate has been evaluated or excluded and none cleared): require at least one candidate with a complete A2 cell; if all candidates were A1-excluded or A2-incomplete -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (partial measurement, no capability verdict). Otherwise: B1 run the bounded external capability check (prereg 8, informational, <= 30 min, non-gating); B2 prompt_attribution=UNDETERMINED (the VF-01 driver question is only decidable for a clearing candidate; that no candidate cleared under P_treat, while the comparator cells reproduce the parent's failure mode, is recorded in a validity note supporting the ceiling reading); B3 OUTCOME=FALSIFIES, status=COMPLETE, with a coverage note naming any candidate that was provisioning-failed or A1-excluded (partial coverage, not MIXED). MEASUREMENT_INVALID is never a capability verdict; every trigger records the exact failed prerequisite and the smallest unblocking action.
product_consequence_positive: SUPPORTS: readiness condition (3) is satisfied by a proven same-model driver. Gate 2 of the frozen C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark converts from FAIL to PASS at the P_treat protocol; Intel hands off the verified credential-free endpoint (model + exact prompt + harness config) so Product/Graph can run the frozen four-arm benchmark (COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER, same model/tools/budget) as specified. Audit VF-01 is retired with evidence: the underspecification was the actionable driver (H1b) or, if prompt_attribution=NOT_PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED, the baseline prompt was weaker than the parent's 0/5 suggested and the endpoint is still usable. C-LLM-INHERIT advances from HYPOTHESIS toward EXPERIMENTAL/VALIDATED; C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY and C-PRODUCT-ECON regain an executable benchmark substrate.
product_consequence_negative: FALSIFIES: the credential-free 0.5B-8B GGUF path is exhausted under factory constraints (CPU-only, huggingface.co resolve-redirect only, llama.cpp 0.2.90) even with a goal/schema prompt; the parent's DESIGN_COMPROMISED boundary is confirmed protocol-stable, and U-01/U-02 in the parent audit are closed (the deficit is below the prompt ceiling). Deliverable: an explicit close/re-scope recommendation to the Global Research Director (prereg 8.3): either a bounded follow-up on a specific external model flagged by the envelope, or the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark is re-scoped off the credential-free path (drop Gate 3 same-model external anchor; internally re-run comparators with retrieval-quality metrics on a dynamic-range task bank where cold/retrieval arms are not at ceiling, per the B2 precedent). C-LLM-INHERIT stays HYPOTHESIS until the re-scoped design is approved.
estimated_cost: ~50-130 min wall time total, CPU-only. Downloads: ~4.7 GB (7B split shards) + ~2.1 GB (3B) + ~0.49 GB (0.5B, only if both larger models fail under treatment), (re-)downloaded via huggingface.co resolve-redirect only if matching-digest files are absent on the EXECUTE runner; bandwidth ~0-7.3 GB. Inference (parent-measured ~5.1 s/call 7B, ~2.2 s/call 3B): per evaluated candidate, 2 prompt conditions x (10 PC probes + up to 25 episode-step calls) = up to ~70 calls; 7B ~70 calls (~6 min) + 3B ~70 calls (~2.5 min) + 0.5B ~70 calls (~1 min) + up to 3 model loads (~2-4 min) + playwright episodes (~2-4 min; failed clicks on a hidden button cost up to 8 s each). Early-success stop avoids the smaller-model cells whenever a larger model clears under treatment. Controls via the repaired controls driver: oracle 5 + NC 5 + B-RANDOM 5 scripted episodes (< 30 s). External capability check: <= 30 min bounded search (websearch + archived leaderboards). No GPU, no paid API, no credential.
expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing in both directions (Director mandate: 'either satisfied by a proven same-model driver or the four-arm benchmark re-scoped off the credential-free path'). This is the single unresolved measurement named by parent audit U-01/U-02 and mandate blocker B3: it separates a prompt/underspecification artifact (would unblock the flagship four-arm benchmark at zero new infrastructure cost) from a model-capability ceiling (closes the credential-free path and triggers an explicit, accountable re-scope), and it inventories the demonstrable ceiling across ALL endpoints/models actually available (0.5B/3B/7B GGUFs re-measured under the identical protocol + non-reproducible proxy carried + bounded external envelope). The within-experiment 2x2 also re-verifies the parent's comparator outcomes for harness-drift detection, and the repaired controls remove a control-sensitivity defect found in the parent packet. Low cost (<= ~2 h, CPU-only) relative to the decision at stake; the bounded external check prevents an unbounded model census (mandate prior B2/B3 anti-pattern).

decision_rule_reachability.reason: The decision rule is a fully enumerated 3-outcome FSM (SUPPORTS / FALSIFIES / MEASUREMENT_INVALID) with a separately evaluated secondary attribution field; every branch terminates and no branch depends on a future-stage value (the A3 comparator is unconditional and precedes A4). SUPPORTS is reachable: PC-ORACLE-EPISODE proved reachable by executing the REAL run_episode scorer at DESIGN time (prereg 13 E-2: 5/5 with a scripted click-then-answer producer), the treatment differs from the parent-failing cell only in the VF-01-identified instruction/schema dimension, and every candidate cell is open in both directions (0/5..5/5). FALSIFIES is reachable: the parent already exhibits the full comparator failure mode (0/5, re-click loop) and the treatment may not fix it; a specific realization path (7B and 3B and 0.5B all <= 2/5 under P_treat with comparator cells ~0/5) is arithmetically consistent with the measured parent outcomes. MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via enumerated preflight/provisioning/complete-cell conditions, all recorded fail-closed. Thresholds are arithmetically attainable: 3/5 = 0.6 exactly at k=3; the bar is NOT at ceiling or floor (parent comparator 0/5; oracle canary 5/5; candidate cells open). Precedence is a strict chain (preflight -> provisioning -> A1 -> A2 -> A3 -> A4 early-stop -> B), so no later branch shadows an earlier one. The external check is explicitly non-gating, so it cannot create an ambiguous or unreachable branch.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Every hard prerequisite is verified-available by (a) the accepted audit-PASS parent packet, which executed the identical stack on the same ubuntu-latest runner image and workflow, and/or (b) DESIGN-time probes recorded in prereg 13. (1) Models: the huggingface.co resolve-redirect route is confirmed (302 -> us.aws.cdn.hf.co); all three frozen URLs (7B shards, 3B, 0.5B) HEAD-verified 302 at DESIGN time; sha256 digests pinned from parent evidence (7B shards dfce12e3862a5283ccfb88221b48480e58745165de856439950d0f22590580db and 539cf93f78e887edea1c04e2d7d8cdaca9d01dae9c9025bcb8accbe29df3d72a; 3B 626b4a6678b86442240e33df819e00132d3ba7dddfe1cdc4fbb18e0a9615c62d) and from the grandparent E-LOCAL-LLAMA receipt (0.5B 74a4da8c9fdbcd15bd1f6d01d621410d31c6fc00986f5eb687824e7b93d7a9db); digest mismatch -> recorded provisioning_failure (U-04-class risk, fail-safe), never silent substitution. Models are remote content identified by frozen URL + pinned sha256 (packet-contract-compliant; content is deterministic, no sampling protocol needed). (2) Libraries: llama-cpp-python 0.2.90 and playwright 1.63.0 pip-installed at EXECUTE (prereg 3.2); the parent installed and used both successfully on the identical image. (3) Browser: system Chrome at /usr/bin/google-chrome, parent-verified headless with --no-sandbox. (4) CPU-only nproc=4, ~14 GB RAM and > 8 GB free disk (7B+3B+0.5B weights ~7.3 GB max); the parent ran the 7B shards identically. (5) Harness code: reuses the audited frozen parent harness (no new scoring machinery); the only new code is the fully specified controls driver whose verbatim source and expected sha256 c2b00d4d1458354ec815c93b6ac2dcf3408c24c94807a4d3e1622b4eee7addc7 are frozen in prereg Appendix A and which EXECUTE materializes byte-identically before running (verified end-to-end at DESIGN time, prereg 13 E-2). No credential, GPU, paid API, or unreachable dataset is required. Install/download failures map to frozen MEASUREMENT_INVALID paths, never to capability verdicts.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Treatment vs comparator differ in EXACTLY one variable: prompts.system content (goal/schema enumeration vs the frozen underspecified string); task page, user_template, GBNF grammar, action schema, sampling, seeds, harness, threshold and scoring are byte-identical, and the candidate_models_frozen extension is identical in both conditions.
